info.name: Adobe Campaign Standard Profile And Services API
info.description:
REST API for Adobe Campaign Standard enabling integration with marketing campaigns, profiles, workflows, and messaging services. Provides CRUD operations for profiles and services, workflow control, transactional messaging triggers, GDPR/CCPA privacy requests, marketing history access, and custom resource management.

Contact Support:
 Name: Adobe Developer Support
